title: 4.3 Where Things Are
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Understand and use in, on, under and next to, and answer Where is the ...? about known things.
grammar_function: Where is the + noun? It is in/on/under/next to the + noun. The bag is on the chair.
prerequisite: 4.1-4.2 rooms and home objects; 2.3 objects; 3.7 where.
speaking_outcome: Ask Where is it? and say where a known thing is.
